blurb: Guests participate in escape room games designed for groups of 2 or 3 players. Pricing varies by group size and game. Reservations require a deposit and have specific cancellation and rescheduling policies.
extraNote: An $80 deposit is required initially; the remaining balance is due upon arrival and can be split if requested. · Full refunds apply for cancellations 48+ hours before booking. · Cancellations with 24–48 hours notice incur a $20 fee. · Less than 24 hours: no refund. · Rescheduling follows similar terms. · A $20 cancellation fee applies; the remaining deposit will be refunded. · A $20 rescheduling fee applies; deposit applied to new date minus fee.
